!! Version 2

!! article
Template:1x
!! text
{{{1}}}
!! endarticle

!! article
Main Page
!! text
Main page content
!! endarticle

!! test
Simple bold text
!! wikitext
'''bold''' text
!! html/parsoid
<p><b>bold</b> text</p>
!! end

!! test
Simple wikilink
!! wikitext
[[Main Page]]
!! html/parsoid
<p><a href="./Main_Page" rel="mw:WikiLink" title="Main Page">Main Page</a></p>
!! end

!! test
Heading level 2
!! wikitext
== Section Title ==
!! html/parsoid
<h2 id="Section_Title">Section Title</h2>
!! end

!! test
Paragraph break
!! wikitext
First paragraph.

Second paragraph.
!! html/parsoid
<p>First paragraph.</p>
<p>Second paragraph.</p>
!! end

!! test
Mixed inline formatting
!! wikitext
''italic'' and '''bold''' and '''''both'''''
!! html/parsoid
<p><i>italic</i> and <b>bold</b> and <i><b>both</b></i></p>
!! end

!! test
Unordered list
!! wikitext
* Item one
* Item two
!! html/parsoid
<ul><li>Item one</li>
<li>Item two</li></ul>
!! end

!! test
Template expansion
!! wikitext
{{1x|hello}}
!! html/parsoid
<p typeof="mw:Transclusion">hello</p>
!! end
